paragraphs.text: Here are some of the frequently asked questions about the tram service in Gobridge town
paragraphs.translation: 以下是一些关于戈布里奇镇有轨电车服务的常见问题

paragraphs.text: When do the trams run?
paragraphs.translation: 电车什么时候运行？

paragraphs.text: Gobridge Tramlink operates a network of trams that run throughout the year and provide links to main services, stations and the airport. Timetables are reviewed in October and March, and may alter slightly so check before you travel. Our first tram from the city centre leaves from Marvin Square at 6.30 am, half an hour after the first city bus service.
paragraphs.translation:
时刻表在10月和3月会进行审核，并可能略有调整，因此出行前请确认。
我们从市中心发出的首班电车于早上6点30分从马文广场出发，比首班
戈布里奇有轨电车系统运营着一整年运行的电车网络，连接主要服务设施、火车站和机场。
时刻表在十月和三月会进行审查，并可能略有调整，因此出行前请核实。
从市中心出发的首班电车于早上6:30从马文广场开出，比第一班城市公交服务晚半小时。

paragraphs.text: Can I get a tram from the airport?
paragraphs.translation: 我可以从机场乘坐有轨电车吗？

paragraphs.text: Trams from the airport to the city centre start running at 6.15 am and leave every fifteen minutes until 7.30 pm when the evening schedule takes over. Trams then run to the main railway station at 35-minute intervals and end at 11.35 pm. If your flight arrives later than this, the number 207 airport bus runs every hour through the night.
paragraphs.translation:
之后电车每隔35分钟一班开往主要火车站，末班车时间为晚上11点35分。
如果你的航班晚于这个时间到达，207路机场巴士整夜每小时一班。
从机场开往市中心的电车从早上6点15分开始运行，每15分钟一班，一直持续到晚上7点30分，届时晚间时刻表开始执行。
然后，电车以每35分钟一班的间隔开往主要火车站，并在晚上11点35分结束运行。
如果你的航班抵达时间晚于这个时间，207路机场巴士整夜每小时一班。

paragraphs.text: What do I do if I don't have a ticket?
paragraphs.translation: 如果我没有车票该怎么办？

paragraphs.text: Tickets are not sold by anyone on the tram. Ticket vending machines are located at all tram shelters. Check your route and make sure you buy the correct price ticket. If the vending machine does not work, you should push the red button on the machine and speak into the microphone. A member of staff will either fix the machine straight away or contact the tram inspector onboard your tram. He or she cannot sell you a ticket, but you will not be obliged to pay the £8 on-board fine for not having one.
paragraphs.translation:
所有电车候车亭都设有售票机。
请核对你的路线，确保购买正确票价的票。
如果自动售票机出现故障，你应该按下机器上的红色按钮，对着麦克风说话。
工作人员会立即修理机器，或者联系你所在电车的检票员。
他或她无法向你出售车票，但你不必因无票而支付8英镑的车内罚款。
电车上不设任何售票人员。
所有电车候车亭均设有自动售票机。
请确认您的路线并确保购买价格正确的车票。
如果自动售票机出现故障，您应按下机器上的红色按钮并对麦克风说话。
工作人员将立即修理机器，或联系您所乘电车上的检票员。
该工作人员无法向您出售车票，但您无需因无票而支付车上的 f8 罚款。

paragraphs.text: Can I take my bike on the tram?
paragraphs.translation: 我可以把自行车带上电车吗？

paragraphs.text: Each tram is licensed to carry a maximum of two bicycles, though drivers may refuse to allow cyclists to get on if the tram is crowded. Bicycles may only be taken on the trams during off-peak travel periods: up to 7.30 am, between 10 am and 2.30 pm and after 7 pm. Festivals and other large events may also mean that bicycles are prohibited as
paragraphs.translation:
自行车只能在非高峰时段带上电车：早上7点30分之前、上午10点至下午2点30分之间以及晚上7点之后。
节日和其他大型活动也可能导致自行车被禁止，因为
每辆有轨电车被许可最多携带两辆自行车，不过如果电车拥挤，司机可能会拒绝让骑行者上车。
自行车只能在非高峰出行时段带上电车：上午7点30分之前、上午10点至下午2点30分之间以及晚上7点之后。

paragraphs.text: trams carry extra passengers at these times. Once on board, riders should remain with their bicycles throughout the journey and ensure they do not obstruct the entrance, exit or any other area of public access.
paragraphs.translation:
上车后，骑车人应在整个旅程中留在自行车旁，并确保自行车不阻塞入口、出口或任何其他公共通道区域。
在这些时段，电车会搭载额外的乘客。
一旦上车，骑行者应在整个旅程中与自行车待在一起，并确保不阻塞入口、出口或任何其他公共通道区域。

paragraphs.text: Adorable knitwear
paragraphs.translation: 可爱的针织衫

paragraphs.text: Online customer reviews
paragraphs.translation: 在线客户评价

paragraphs.text: A Mary-Anne
paragraphs.translation: A 玛丽-安

paragraphs.text: I spent a while thinking about buying this sweater because of the price, but I'm glad I finally did. It's a long sweater but that's good as I'm quite tall. I normally find that the sleeves are too short when I try on a top, but not with this one. I tend to take medium but went for large, which was a wise decision as there is plenty of room for a T-shirt underneath when I wear it with jeans.
paragraphs.translation:
我花了一些时间考虑是否要买这件毛衣，因为它的价格，但我很高兴最终还是买了。
这是一件长款毛衣，但这很好，因为我个子很高。
我通常试穿上衣时会发现袖子太短，但这件不会。
我通常穿中号，但选了加大号，这是一个明智的决定，因为当我搭配牛仔裤穿时，里面还有充足的空间穿一件T恤。

paragraphs.text: B Davina
paragraphs.translation: B 戴维娜

paragraphs.text: These sweaters are an ideal weight for office wear. The purple one is pretty, though I expected a lighter shade from the picture. I wear a US size 12 UK 16, and the medium is big enough to fit over a shirt with room to spare. It has long sleeves that I love to roll up at the wrist. I'm now trying to resist the temptation to buy it in grey too.
paragraphs.translation:
这些毛衣的重量非常适合在办公室穿着。
紫色的那件很漂亮，尽管我根据图片预期的是更浅的色调。
我穿美国尺码12号、英国尺码16号，而中号大到足以套在衬衫外面，还有余量。
它有长袖，我喜欢在手腕处卷起来。
我现在正努力抵制再买一件灰色款的诱惑。

paragraphs.text: C Naga
paragraphs.translation: C 娜迦

paragraphs.text: This knitted sweater looks great in the pictures. I ordered the olive green with stripes and, although I wasn't sure it was going to look right on me, I was pleasantly surprised when I put it on. It's very soft and I love the long past-the-wrist sleeves too. I opted for the medium, but it was too tight so I exchanged it.
paragraphs.translation:
这款针织毛衣在图片中看起来很棒。
我订购了带条纹的橄榄绿色，尽管我不确定它穿在我身上是否合适，但穿上后我惊喜地发现效果很好。
它非常柔软，我也很喜欢那长过手腕的袖子。
我选了中号，但太紧了，所以我换了它。

paragraphs.text: D Libby
paragraphs.translation: D 莉比

paragraphs.text: This is the third of your sweaters that I've bought over the past two years. It's true to size and perfect for the winter months, though I should add that its loose knit means it's best to avoid playing with cats or young dogs when you're wearing it as they could pull threads in the body or sleeves.
paragraphs.translation:
这是我在过去两年里买的你的第三件毛衣。
它尺码准确，非常适合冬季穿着，不过我应该补充一点，它的宽松编织意味着当你穿着它时最好避免与猫或幼犬玩耍，因为它们可能会拉扯衣身或袖子的线头。

paragraphs.text: E Laura
paragraphs.translation: E 劳拉

paragraphs.text: I couldn't decide which colour to get so I bought the deep blue and the charcoal grey, with every intention of sending one of them back. That didn't happen, of course! I would say both colours match the online pictures. I bought size small, and the length is perfect for me, despite the unnecessarily long sleeves! These sweaters are lovely to wear with jeans but also stylish enough to wear to work.
paragraphs.translation:
我无法决定选哪种颜色，于是买了深蓝色和炭灰色，原本打算退回其中一件。
当然，那并没有发生！
我得说这两种颜色都与网上的图片相符。
我买了小号，长度对我来说很完美，尽管袖子长得没有必要！
这些毛衣搭配牛仔裤穿很好看，但也足够时尚，可以穿去上班。

groups.instructions:
Questions 1 - 7
Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 1?
Choose TRUE if the statement agrees with the information given in the text, choose FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or choose NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt: The city buses start operating later than the trams.
questions.analysis: 题干称“城市公交车比电车开始运营得晚”，但原文明确指出“从市中心发出的首班电车在早上6:30，比首班城市公交晚半小时”，说明公交车实际上更早发车。因此，题干与原文信息矛盾，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 原文明确电车在公交车之后半小时发车。
questions.location_analysis: 电车比公交车早半小时，故说法矛盾。
questions.paraphrasing: start operating later -> first tram... half an hour after the first city bus service
questions.keywords: city buses, start operating, later than trams
evidence: Our first tram from the city centre leaves from Marvin Square at 6.30 am, half an hour after the first city bus service.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文可能表明公交车开始运营早于或等于电车，与题干矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确比较了公交车和电车的开始运营时间，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: You can get a tram from the airport to the city centre up to midnight.
questions.analysis: 题干说“从机场到市中心的电车可运行至午夜”，但原文提到“晚间时刻表下，电车最晚一班在晚上11:35结束”，并未运行到午夜（即12点）。因此该说法与原文不符，答案为FALSE。
questions.location_analysis: 电车11:35pm结束，未到午夜，不符。
questions.paraphrasing: up to midnight -> end at 11.35 pm
questions.keywords: airport to city centre, up to midnight
evidence: Trams then run to the main railway station at 35-minute intervals and end at 11.35 pm.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文明确电车服务时间并非至午夜，该选项与原文信息矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了相关时间信息，该选项错误地认为信息未提及。

questions.prompt: The 207 bus service stops at the main railway station.
questions.analysis: 题干询问“207路公交车是否停靠主火车站”，但原文仅说明“若航班晚于11:35抵达，207路机场巴士整夜每小时一班”，并未提及该巴士是否停靠主火车站。因此文中无相关信息，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 原文未说明公交车路线站点。
questions.location_analysis: 未提及207路是否停靠火车站。
questions.paraphrasing: 207 airport bus -> number 207 airport bus
evidence: If your flight arrives later than this, the number 207 airport bus runs every hour through the night.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及207路公交车是否在主要火车站停靠，因此无法判断为真。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提及207路公交车不在主要火车站停靠，因此无法判断为假。

questions.prompt: The cost of a tram ticket varies depending on your journey.
questions.analysis: 题干称“电车票价根据行程不同而变化”，原文中提到“请确认您的路线并购买正确价格的车票”，暗示不同路线对应不同票价。因此该说法与原文一致，答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 指示按路线购买正确票价。
questions.location_analysis: 不同路线对应不同票价。
questions.paraphrasing: cost varies -> buy the correct price ticket
evidence: Check your route and make sure you buy the correct price ticket.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确说明票价因旅程而异，因此该选项与实际信息矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了票价与旅程的关系，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Bicycles are allowed on the trams between 7.30 am and 10 am.
questions.analysis: 题干称“自行车可在早上7:30至10点之间带上电车”，但原文规定允许携带自行车的非高峰时段为“早上7:30前、上午10点至下午2:30之间，以及晚上7点后”，7:30–10:00这一时间段并不包含在内。因此说法错误，答案为FALSE。
questions.location_analysis: 7:30-10期间不允许，与原文off-peak时段矛盾。
questions.paraphrasing: allowed between 7.30-10 -> allowed up to 7.30 am, between 10 am and 2.30 pm
questions.keywords: bicycles allowed, between 7.30 am and 10 am
evidence: Bicycles may only be taken on the trams during off-peak travel periods: up to 7.30 am, between 10 am and 2.30 pm and after 7 pm.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文信息矛盾，原文表明此时段不允许自行车上电车。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确提及了自行车在此时段能否上电车，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Additional trams run during the Gobridge festival period.
questions.analysis: 题干称“节日期间会增开额外电车”，但原文只提到“节庆或大型活动期间，因乘客增多，可能禁止携带自行车”，并未提及是否会增加电车班次。因此文中无此信息，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.location_analysis: 提及可能禁止自行车，未提增开列车。
questions.paraphrasing: additional trams -> extra passengers, prohibited
evidence: Festivals and other large events may also mean that bicycles are prohibited as trams carry extra passengers at these times.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及Gobridge节日期间有额外电车运行，因此该选项无依据。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提供相关信息，无法判断是否没有额外电车，因此该选项无根据。

questions.prompt: Cyclists may be asked to leave the tram if they block the exit.
questions.analysis: 题干称“如果骑车者挡住出口，可能会被要求下车”，但原文仅说明“司机可在电车拥挤时拒绝骑车者上车”，并未提到已上车者因阻塞通道而被要求离开。因此文中无此信息，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 未提及因阻塞出口而被要求下车。
questions.location_analysis: 提到拒绝上车，但不是要求已上车者离开。
questions.paraphrasing: asked to leave -> drivers may refuse to allow cyclists to get on
questions.keywords: cyclists, asked to leave, block exit
evidence: Each tram is licensed to carry a maximum of two bicycles, though drivers may refuse to allow cyclists to get on if the tram is crowded.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及骑行者堵塞出口会被要求离开电车，属于无中生有。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未明确否定这一说法，无法判断其真假，因此不能选FALSE。

groups.instructions:
Questions 8 - 14
Look at the five online customer reviews of sweaters, A-E.
For which review are the following statements true?
Choose the correct letter, A-E.
NB You may use any letter more than once.

questions.prompt: The colour of the sweater did not match the website image.
questions.analysis: 题干问哪位顾客“花了些时间才决定购买”，Review B（Davina）提到“紫色毛衣很漂亮，但图片颜色比我预期的浅”，说明她对颜色有疑虑；但真正符合“花时间决定”的是Review A（Mary-Anne），她明确说“因为价格犹豫了一阵子才买”。然而根据中央句提示，此处应指颜色不符，对应B。结合题干描述“颜色与网站图片不符”，B中“expected a lighter shade from the picture”表明颜色不匹配，故答案为B。
questions.location_analysis: Davina说颜色比图片暗。
questions.paraphrasing: colour did not match -> expected a lighter shade from the picture
questions.keywords: colour, did not match, website image
evidence: The purple one is pretty, though I expected a lighter shade from the picture.

questions.prompt: The customer took some time to decide on the purchase.
questions.analysis: 题干问哪位顾客“花了一些时间才决定购买”，Review A（Mary-Anne）开头就说“I spent a while thinking about buying this sweater because of the price”，明确表示因价格犹豫了一段时间，最终才购买。因此答案为A。
questions.location_analysis: Mary-Anne考虑了一段时间才买。
questions.paraphrasing: took time to decide -> spent a while thinking about buying
evidence: I spent a while thinking about buying this sweater because of the price, but I'm glad I finally did.

questions.prompt: The customer initially bought the wrong size.
questions.analysis: 题干问哪位顾客“最初买错了尺码”，Review C（Naga）提到“I opted for the medium, but it was too tight so I exchanged it”，说明她先买了M码，发现太紧后换货，符合“最初买错尺码”的描述，因此答案为C。
questions.location_analysis: Naga先买M码，太紧换货。
questions.paraphrasing: initially bought wrong size -> opted for the medium, but it was too tight so I exchanged it
evidence: I opted for the medium, but it was too tight so I exchanged it.

questions.prompt: The customer changed her mind about returning a sweater.
questions.analysis: 题干问哪位顾客“改变了退货的主意”，Review E（Laura）写道“I bought the deep blue and the charcoal grey, with every intention of sending one of them back. That didn't happen, of course!”，明确表示原本打算退一件，但最后没退，符合题意，因此答案为E。
questions.location_analysis: Laura原本要退一件，但没退。
questions.paraphrasing: changed mind about returning -> with every intention of sending one of them back. That didn't happen
evidence: I bought the deep blue and the charcoal grey, with every intention of sending one of them back. That didn't happen, of course!

questions.prompt: The customer bought a bigger size than she usually does.
questions.analysis: 题干问哪位顾客“买了比平时更大的尺码”，Review A（Mary-Anne）说“I tend to take medium but went for large”，表明她通常穿M码，这次选了L码，符合“买了更大尺码”的描述，因此答案为A。
questions.location_analysis: Mary-Anne通常M码，买了L码。
questions.paraphrasing: bought bigger size -> I tend to take medium but went for large
evidence: I tend to take medium but went for large, which was a wise decision as there is plenty of room for a T-shirt underneath when I wear it with jeans.

questions.prompt: The sweater can be worn for smart or casual occasions.
questions.analysis: 题干问哪位顾客认为“毛衣既适合休闲也适合正式场合”，Review E（Laura）提到“These sweaters are lovely to wear with jeans but also stylish enough to wear to work”，其中“配牛仔裤”代表休闲，“上班穿”代表正式场合，完全对应题干，因此答案为E。
questions.location_analysis: Laura认为可穿上班（正式）或配牛仔裤（休闲）。
questions.paraphrasing: smart or casual -> lovely to wear with jeans but also stylish enough to wear to work
questions.keywords: sweater can be worn for smart or casual occasions
evidence: These sweaters are lovely to wear with jeans but also stylish enough to wear to work.

questions.prompt: The customer was worried that the sweater wouldn't suit her.
questions.analysis: 题干问哪位顾客“担心毛衣不适合自己”，Review C（Naga）写道“although I wasn't sure it was going to look right on me, I was pleasantly surprised when I put it on”，明确表达了对是否适合自己外貌的担忧，因此答案为C。
questions.location_analysis: Naga不确定是否适合自己。
questions.paraphrasing: worried it wouldn't suit -> wasn't sure it was going to look right on me
evidence: I ordered the olive green with stripes and, although I wasn't sure it was going to look right on me, I was pleasantly surprised when I put it on.

sentence_translations.sentence: 2. When do the trams run?

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: How to become a great leader

paragraphs.text: Stepping into a new management role can be unnerving. Here's how to inspire your team:
paragraphs.translation:
踏入新的管理岗位可能会令人不安。
以下是如何激励你的团队的方法：

paragraphs.text: Set the tone of your leadership style from the outset. Be confident, self-assured and respectful with everyone you meet. Speak as you want to be spoken to, and remember to listen. The first few weeks is when people develop their perceptions of you, so work hard to earn their trust. This will be key to effective change and progress.
paragraphs.translation:
从一开始就设定好你的领导风格基调。
对你遇到的每一个人都要保持自信、沉着和尊重。
以你希望被对待的方式说话，并牢记倾听。
最初几周是人们对你的印象形成期，因此要努力赢得他们的信任。
这对于有效的变革与进步至关重要。

paragraphs.text: Part of a leader's brief is to set bold goals. They could take years to achieve, but they need to be specific enough that everyone in the organisation understands them, buys into them and is willing to work together to achieve them.
paragraphs.translation:
领导者的职责之一是设定大胆的目标。
这些目标可能需要多年才能实现，但它们必须足够具体，以便组织中的每个人都能理解、认同并愿意共同努力去达成。

paragraphs.text: Don't do everything yourself. Great leaders surround themselves with talented individuals and they should trust them to make things happen. If things need changing, tell people and involve them in making the changes by participating in the design of a new strategy. If the team is too cautious to embrace change, give them one more chance but be clearer about what you want.
paragraphs.translation:
不要凡事亲力亲为。
优秀的领导者身边聚集着有才华的人才，并且他们应当信任这些人去推动事情完成。
如果事情需要改变，要告知他人，并让他们通过参与设计来共同做出改变

paragraphs.text: Stamp out the 'them and us' culture. In many organisations, employees feel distant from senior management. The message must be plain: we all work together, but leaders need to work hard to ensure this filters through to everyone in the organisation.
paragraphs.translation:
消除'他们和我们'的对立文化。
在许多组织中，员工感觉与高层管理疏远。
信息必须明确：我们所有人共同合作，但领导者需要努力确保这一点传达到组织中的每一个人。

paragraphs.text: Allow time for innovation. It's important to give staff time to come up with new ideas and solutions that will fix new problems. However, be clear that a decision is expected; set a time limit and stick to it.
paragraphs.translation:
为创新留出时间。
给予员工时间提出能够解决新问题的新想法和解决方案，这一点很重要。
然而，要明确期望做出决定；设定一个时间限制并严格遵守。

paragraphs.text: It is likely that the formula that makes the business you are managing successful will have been created many years ago - but it's important to remember how the business started. Honour those early pioneers and instil a sense of pride across the organisation.
paragraphs.translation:
很可能使你正在管理的企业取得成功的模式是多年前就已形成的——但重要的是要记住企业是如何起步的。
尊重那些早期的先驱者，并在整个组织中灌输一种自豪感。

paragraphs.text: Leaders need to accept that some risk may be required if the situation calls for it. Playing it safe is never a good business rule, and leaders must make sure their business stays ahead by being prepared to act quickly.
paragraphs.translation:
领导者需要接受，如果情况需要，可能必须承担一定的风险。
稳扎稳打从来都不是一条好的商业准则，领导者必须确保其企业通过准备迅速行动来保持领先地位。

paragraphs.text: Show you are passionate and enthusiastic. People spend a large part of their lives working for an organisation, and having a leader who is genuinely thrilled about its future is hugely inspiring.
paragraphs.translation:
展现你的热情与积极。
人们一生中很大一部分时间都在为某个组织工作，而拥有一位对其未来真正充满期待的领导者，会带来巨大的鼓舞。

paragraphs.text: Resigning from a job in a professional manner
paragraphs.translation: 以专业的方式辞职

paragraphs.text: When you take the decision to resign and move on to another job, you might really want to dance your way out of the door, or get your own back by criticising your boss to the whole office. But you need to resist these temptations because in future you might find you're working with your ex-line manager or other colleagues in a different company.
paragraphs.translation:
当你决定辞职并转而从事另一份工作时，你可能会很想兴高采烈地走出大门，或者通过在整个办公室批评你的老板来报复他。
但你需要抵制这些诱惑，因为将来你可能会发现自己在另一家公司与你的前直属经理或其他同事共事。

paragraphs.text: Letting your manager know
paragraphs.translation: 让你的经理知晓

paragraphs.text: Show courtesy by telling your boss first. Request a meeting to say that you're leaving, following up soon after with an official letter. Before the meeting with your boss, write a list of ongoing tasks along with status updates and suggestions concerning completion. Use the meeting to clarify any other points, such as your notice period and leaving date, and how you will inform others (colleagues or external clients, contacts and suppliers). Ask about a reference too; your employer may only supply the most basic type but your line manager might also give you a more personal one. Making sure you get a good one can make subsequent job hunting less stressful.
paragraphs.translation:
以礼貌为先，首先告知你的上司。
请求安排一次会议说明你要离职，并随后尽快提交正式的信函。
在与老板会面之前，列出一份正在进行的任务清单，附上进度更新以及关于完成工作的建议。
利用会议澄清其他要点，比如你的通知期和离职日期，以及你将如何告知他人（同事或外部客户、联系人和供应商）。
也询问一下推荐信；你的雇主可能只提供最基本的类型，但你的直属主管或许能给你一份更具个人特色的推荐信。
确保获得一份好的推荐信可以让后续的求职过程减轻压力。

paragraphs.text: Preparation
paragraphs.translation: 准备工作

paragraphs.text: Work out how you can ensure a smooth transition and minimise disruption to your employer. There may be a range of things you can do to hand over professionally, such as completing projects, working out the priorities with your line manager, and leaving clear documentation for the successor in your post concerning processes or software.
paragraphs.translation:
思考如何确保平稳过渡，并尽量减少对雇主的干扰。
你可能需要做一系列事情来专业地交接工作，例如完成项目、与直属上级确定优先事项，以及为接任者留下关于流程或软件的清晰文件。

paragraphs.text: Your letter of resignation
paragraphs.translation: 你的辞职信

paragraphs.text: Keep your letter short. You don't need to give lots of explanations or justification for why you're leaving. Don't be tempted to address the failings of the company or your boss, either. Instead, thanking your employer for the job and mentioning what you appreciated about it is a graceful touch. Here's an idea of what to include:
paragraphs.translation:
保持信函简短。
你无需为离开的原因提供大量解释或理由。
也不要试图指出公司或上司的不足之处。
相反，感谢雇主给予的工作机会并提及你所珍视的方面是一种得体的做法。
以下是一份内容建议：

paragraphs.text: ● First paragraph - the basics
paragraphs.translation: 第一段——基本信息

paragraphs.text: Inform the employer that you wish to resign and confirm the agreed final date at work.
paragraphs.translation: 告知雇主你希望辞职，并确认双方商定的最后工作日。

paragraphs.text: ● Second paragraph - thank your employer
paragraphs.translation: ● 第二段——感谢你的雇主

paragraphs.text: Mention any particular career-building projects you worked on or opportunities to develop skills and contribute to the employer's goals and successes. You can also mention your appreciation at being able to work in a great team.
paragraphs.translation:
提及你参与的任何特别有助于职业发展的项目，或是提升技能、为雇主的目与成功做出贡献的机会。
你也可以表达对能在优秀团队中工作的感激之情。

paragraphs.text: ● Third paragraph - handover
paragraphs.translation: ● 第三段——工作交接

paragraphs.text: State your willingness to finish existing projects and hand over your work smoothly.
paragraphs.translation: 表明你愿意完成现有项目并顺利移交工作。

parts.source_article_title: How to become a great leader

sentence_translations.sentence: Stepping into a new management role can be unnerving.
sentence_translations.translation: 踏入新的管理岗位可能会令人不安。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here's how to inspire your team:
sentence_translations.translation: 以下是如何激励你的团队的方法：

sentence_translations.sentence: Set the tone of your leadership style from the outset.
sentence_translations.translation: 从一开始就设定好你的领导风格基调。

sentence_translations.sentence: Be confident, self-assured and respectful with everyone you meet.
sentence_translations.translation: 对你遇到的每一个人都要保持自信、沉着和尊重。

sentence_translations.sentence: Speak as you want to be spoken to, and remember to listen.
sentence_translations.translation: 以你希望被对待的方式说话，并牢记倾听。

sentence_translations.sentence: The first few weeks is when people develop their perceptions of you, so work hard to earn their trust.
sentence_translations.translation: 最初几周是人们对你的印象形成期，因此要努力赢得他们的信任。

sentence_translations.sentence: This will be key to effective change and progress.
sentence_translations.translation: 这对于有效的变革与进步至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Part of a leader's brief is to set bold goals.
sentence_translations.translation: 领导者的职责之一是设定大胆的目标。

sentence_translations.sentence: They could take years to achieve, but they need to be specific enough that everyone in the organisation understands them, buys into them and is willing to work together to achieve them.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些目标可能需要多年才能实现，但它们必须足够具体，以便组织中的每个人都能理解、认同并愿意共同努力去达成。

sentence_translations.sentence: Don't do everything yourself.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要凡事亲力亲为。

sentence_translations.sentence: Great leaders surround themselves with talented individuals and they should trust them to make things happen.
sentence_translations.translation: 优秀的领导者身边聚集着有才华的人才，并且他们应当信任这些人去推动事情完成。

sentence_translations.sentence: If things need changing, tell people and involve them in making the changes by participating in the design of
sentence_translations.translation: 如果事情需要改变，要告知他人，并让他们通过参与设计来共同做出改变

sentence_translations.sentence: a new strategy.
sentence_translations.translation: 一个新策略。

sentence_translations.sentence: If the team is too cautious to embrace change, give them one more chance but be clearer about what you want.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果团队过于谨慎而不愿接受变化，再给他们一次机会，但对你想要的东西要表达得更清楚。

sentence_translations.sentence: Stamp out the 'them and us' culture.
sentence_translations.translation: 消除'他们和我们'的对立文化。

sentence_translations.sentence: In many organisations, employees feel distant from senior management.
sentence_translations.translation: 在许多组织中，员工感觉与高层管理疏远。

sentence_translations.sentence: The message must be plain: we all work together, but leaders need to work hard to ensure this filters through to everyone in the organisation.
sentence_translations.translation: 信息必须明确：我们所有人共同合作，但领导者需要努力确保这一点传达到组织中的每一个人。

sentence_translations.sentence: Allow time for innovation.
sentence_translations.translation: 为创新留出时间。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's important to give staff time to come up with new ideas and solutions that will fix new problems.
sentence_translations.translation: 给予员工时间提出能够解决新问题的新想法和解决方案，这一点很重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, be clear that a decision is expected; set a time limit and stick to it.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，要明确期望做出决定；设定一个时间限制并严格遵守。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is likely that the formula that makes the business you are managing successful will have been created many years ago - but it's important to remember how the business started.
sentence_translations.translation: 很可能使你正在管理的企业取得成功的模式是多年前就已形成的——但重要的是要记住企业是如何起步的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Honour those early pioneers and instil a sense of pride across the organisation.
sentence_translations.translation: 尊重那些早期的先驱者，并在整个组织中灌输一种自豪感。

sentence_translations.sentence: Leaders need to accept that some risk may be required if the situation calls for it.
sentence_translations.translation: 领导者需要接受，如果情况需要，可能必须承担一定的风险。

sentence_translations.sentence: Playing it safe is never a good business rule, and leaders must make sure their business stays ahead by being prepared to act quickly.
sentence_translations.translation: 稳扎稳打从来都不是一条好的商业准则，领导者必须确保其企业通过准备迅速行动来保持领先地位。

sentence_translations.sentence: Show you are passionate and enthusiastic.
sentence_translations.translation: 展现你的热情与积极。

sentence_translations.sentence: People spend a large part of their lives working for an organisation, and having a leader who is genuinely thrilled about its future is hugely inspiring.
sentence_translations.translation: 人们一生中很大一部分时间都在为某个组织工作，而拥有一位对其未来真正充满期待的领导者，会带来巨大的鼓舞。

sentence_translations.sentence: Resigning from a job in a professional manner
sentence_translations.translation: 以专业的方式辞职

sentence_translations.sentence: When you take the decision to resign and move on to another job, you might really want to dance your way out of the door, or get your own back by criticising your boss to the whole office.
sentence_translations.translation: 当你决定辞职并转而从事另一份工作时，你可能会很想兴高采烈地走出大门，或者通过在整个办公室批评你的老板来报复他。

sentence_translations.sentence: But you need to resist these temptations because in future you might find you're working with your ex-line manager or other colleagues in a different company.
sentence_translations.translation: 但你需要抵制这些诱惑，因为将来你可能会发现自己在另一家公司与你的前直属经理或其他同事共事。

sentence_translations.sentence: Letting your manager know
sentence_translations.translation: 让你的经理知晓

sentence_translations.sentence: Show courtesy by telling your boss first.
sentence_translations.translation: 以礼貌为先，首先告知你的上司。

sentence_translations.sentence: Request a meeting to say that you're leaving, following up soon after with an official letter.
sentence_translations.translation: 请求安排一次会议说明你要离职，并随后尽快提交正式的信函。

sentence_translations.sentence: Before the meeting with your boss, write a list of ongoing tasks along with status updates and suggestions concerning completion.
sentence_translations.translation: 在与老板会面之前，列出一份正在进行的任务清单，附上进度更新以及关于完成工作的建议。

sentence_translations.sentence: Use the meeting to clarify any other points, such as your notice period and leaving date, and how you will inform others (colleagues or external clients, contacts and suppliers).
sentence_translations.translation: 利用会议澄清其他要点，比如你的通知期和离职日期，以及你将如何告知他人（同事或外部客户、联系人和供应商）。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ask about a reference too; your employer may only supply the most basic type but your line manager might also give you a more personal one.
sentence_translations.translation: 也询问一下推荐信；你的雇主可能只提供最基本的类型，但你的直属主管或许能给你一份更具个人特色的推荐信。

sentence_translations.sentence: Making sure you get a good one can make subsequent job hunting less stressful.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保获得一份好的推荐信可以让后续的求职过程减轻压力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Preparation
sentence_translations.translation: 准备工作

sentence_translations.sentence: Work out how you can ensure a smooth transition and minimise disruption to your employer.
sentence_translations.translation: 思考如何确保平稳过渡，并尽量减少对雇主的干扰。

sentence_translations.sentence: There may be a range of things you can do to hand over professionally, such as completing projects, working out the priorities with your line manager, and leaving clear documentation for the successor in your post concerning processes or software.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可能需要做一系列事情来专业地交接工作，例如完成项目、与直属上级确定优先事项，以及为接任者留下关于流程或软件的清晰文件。

sentence_translations.sentence: Your letter of resignation
sentence_translations.translation: 你的辞职信

sentence_translations.sentence: Keep your letter short.
sentence_translations.translation: 保持信函简短。

sentence_translations.sentence: You don't need to give lots of explanations or justification for why you're leaving.
sentence_translations.translation: 你无需为离开的原因提供大量解释或理由。

sentence_translations.sentence: Don't be tempted to address the failings of the company or your boss, either.
sentence_translations.translation: 也不要试图指出公司或上司的不足之处。

sentence_translations.sentence: Instead, thanking your employer for the job and mentioning what you appreciated about it is a graceful touch.
sentence_translations.translation: 相反，感谢雇主给予的工作机会并提及你所珍视的方面是一种得体的做法。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here's an idea of what to include:
sentence_translations.translation: 以下是一份内容建议：

sentence_translations.sentence: First paragraph - the basics
sentence_translations.translation: 第一段——基本信息

sentence_translations.sentence: Inform the employer that you wish to resign and confirm the agreed final date at work.
sentence_translations.translation: 告知雇主你希望辞职，并确认双方商定的最后工作日。

sentence_translations.sentence: ● Second paragraph - thank your employer
sentence_translations.translation: ● 第二段——感谢你的雇主

sentence_translations.sentence: Mention any particular career-building projects you worked on or opportunities to develop skills and contribute to the employer's goals and successes.
sentence_translations.translation: 提及你参与的任何特别有助于职业发展的项目，或是提升技能、为雇主的目与成功做出贡献的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can also mention your appreciation at being able to work in a great team.
sentence_translations.translation: 你也可以表达对能在优秀团队中工作的感激之情。

sentence_translations.sentence: ● Third paragraph - handover
sentence_translations.translation: ● 第三段——工作交接

sentence_translations.sentence: State your willingness to finish existing projects and hand over your work smoothly.
sentence_translations.translation: 表明你愿意完成现有项目并顺利移交工作。

Language always changes, of course. This is one of the few constants about it. But it's arguably changing at a faster rate now than at any previous moment in its history. And emojis-the set of picture characters that people use to punctuate their online correspondence-are at the forefront of this frenzy for change.

语言当然总是在变化。
这是语言为数不多的恒定特征之一。

而表情符号——人们在网络通信中用来点缀文字的一组图形字符——正处在这场变革狂潮的前沿。

paragraphs.text: As a form of global communication, emojis only began their growth in 2011. Four years later, it was estimated that they were being used by over 90 per cent of the online population. In excess of six billion were being sent every day. Their prevalence in the culture was such that Oxford Dictionaries recently chose one as their word of the year.'Words of the Year' are those judged to be reflective of the ethos, mood, or preoccupations of that particular year'. They're very much of their time. And often, once that time has passed, they fade from people's consciousness almost as quickly as they arose.
paragraphs.translation:
作为一种全球交流形式，表情符号仅在2011年才开始其发展。
四年后，据估计超过90%的在线人口正在使用它们。
每天发送的表情符号超过60亿个。
它们在文化中的普及程度如此之高，以至于牛津词典最近将其中一个选为年度词汇。
“年度词汇”指的是那些被认为反映了特定年份的精神、情绪或关注焦点的词汇。
它们非常具有时代特征。
而且，通常一旦那个时代过去，它们从人们意识中消失的速度几乎与其兴起时一样快。

paragraphs.text: There's a good chance, then, that the emoji chosen by Oxford Dictionaries-the 'face with tears of joy'-will also appear to be dated in a few years. But the reasons for this offer a fascinating insight into the way that society is evolving. The little yellow circle with dots for eyes acts as a surprisingly good lens through which to view the history of human communication, and to predict its future.
paragraphs.translation:
因此，牛津词典选出的表情符号——“笑哭脸”——很可能在几年后也会显得过时。
但其中的原因为我们提供了一个有趣的视角，来洞察社会演变的方式。
这个带有圆点眼睛的黄色小圆圈，竟成为了一个极佳的透镜，透过它我们可以审视人类交流的历史，并预测其未来。

But what's interesting about emojis is that they've contributed to this ever-expanding storehouse in a different way. 在我们历史的这一时刻，词汇中的空白不仅仅由新词填补，而是由一种全新的表达体系来填补。

paragraphs.text: C

The second major reason that language changes is down to technology-specifically, the ways in which the technologies we use have an effect on the process of communication itself. Both hardware and new technologies result in us subtly changing the way we interact with each other and also altering the shape of the language we use.

语言变化的第二个主要原因在于技术，具体来说，便是我们使用的技术对交流过程本身产生影响的方式。

硬件和新技术都促使我们微妙地改变彼此互动的方式，同时也改变了我们所用语言的形态。

paragraphs.text: Emojis have evolved as a solution to the needs of mobile communication. In particular, they compensate for the way that computer-mediated messaging on smartphones can sometimes tend towards the emotionally empty. Whereas face to-face, or even voice-to-voice, conversations can express emotional closeness through facial expression or tone of voice, this is easy to miss when messages are rendered in a few short words on a small screen. Emojis are a means of restoring this emotional framing to an interaction-punctuating your message with a smile.
paragraphs.translation:
表情符号已演变为满足移动通信需求的解决方案。
具体来说，它们弥补了智能手机上通过计算机中介的信息传递有时可能趋于情感空洞的缺陷。
尽管面对面甚至语音对话可以通过面部表情或语调表达情感亲近，但当信息在小屏幕上以简短词语呈现时，这种情感很容易被忽略。
表情符号是一种在互动中恢复这种情感框架的方式——用微笑来点缀你的信息。

paragraphs.text: D

But unlike almost any other type of language system, emojis have something akin to a built-in obsolescence. Just as smartphones and their operating systems have a frequent refresh rate, emojis also get routine enhancements. The emojis you have on your phone now will undergo subtle redesigns over the course of time, and extra characters will be added. Because of this, their usefulness is artificially limited.

但与几乎任何其他类型的语言系统不同，表情符号具有某种类似内置过时性的特征。
正如智能手机及其操作系统频繁更新换代一样，表情符号也定期得到增强。
你现在手机上的表情符号会随着时间的推移经历细微的重新设计，并且还会添加额外的字符。
正因如此，它们的实用性被人为地限制了。

paragraphs.text: In the context of communication systems, this is something that's never previously been the case. Twenty years ago, people might have bought a new landline phone when they were tired of the design of their old phone or if they wanted to get one with whatever latest innovation was going around-an inbuilt answering machine, say. But they didn't have to upgrade the language they were using as well.
paragraphs.translation:
在通信系统的背景下，这种情况前所未有。
二十年前，当人们厌倦了旧电话的设计，或者想要拥有一款搭载当下最新创新（例如内置应答机）的电话时，他们可能会购买一部新的固定电话。
但他们不必同时升级所使用的语言。

paragraphs.text: Emojis, on the other hand, are a case study of how technology and the human capacity for communication are working together-of how the onward march of technology exists at the intersection of consumerism, innovation and design. Moreover, the fact that they're at the front line of a relentless wave of technologically driven change in communications practices encourages-if not necessitates -a great amount of creativity in the way they're used.

另一方面，表情符号则是一个案例研究，展示了科技与人类沟通能力如何协同作用——也展示了技术的持续进步如何存在于消费主义、创新与设计的交汇点上。

Emojis are the subject of musicals and Hollywood films. They're the inspiration for fashion design, art and architecture. They're a staple in advertising and commerce. sentence_translations.sentence: Four years later, it was estimated that they were being used by over 90 per cent of the online population.
sentence_translations.translation: 四年后，据估计超过90%的在线人口正在使用它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: In excess of six billion were being sent every day.
sentence_translations.translation: 每天发送的表情符号超过60亿个。

sentence_translations.sentence: Their prevalence in the culture was such that Oxford Dictionaries recently chose one as their word of the year.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们在文化中的普及程度如此之高，以至于牛津词典最近将其中一个选为年度词汇。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'Words of the Year' are those judged to be reflective of the ethos, mood, or preoccupations of that particular year'.
sentence_translations.translation: “年度词汇”指的是那些被认为反映了特定年份的精神、情绪或关注焦点的词汇。

sentence_translations.sentence: They're very much of their time.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们非常具有时代特征。

sentence_translations.sentence: And often, once that time has passed, they fade from people's consciousness almost as quickly as they arose.
sentence_translations.translation: 而且，通常一旦那个时代过去，它们从人们意识中消失的速度几乎与其兴起时一样快。

sentence_translations.sentence: There's a good chance, then, that the emoji chosen by Oxford Dictionaries-the 'face with tears of joy'-will also appear to be dated in a few years.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，牛津词典选出的表情符号——“笑哭脸”——很可能在几年后也会显得过时。

sentence_translations.sentence: But the reasons for this offer a fascinating insight into the way that society is evolving.
sentence_translations.translation: 但其中的原因为我们提供了一个有趣的视角，来洞察社会演变的方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: The little yellow circle with dots for eyes acts as a surprisingly good lens through which to view the history of human communication, and to predict its future.
sentence_translations.translation: 这个带有圆点眼睛的黄色小圆圈，竟成为了一个极佳的透镜，透过它我们可以审视人类交流的历史，并预测其未来。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are two main reasons why language changes.
sentence_translations.translation: 语言变化主要有两个原因。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are two main reasons why language changes.
sentence_translations.translation: 语言变化主要有两个原因。

sentence_translations.sentence: One is to do with the way that language mirrors the changes in how we relate to each other.
sentence_translations.translation: 其一与语言反映我们彼此关系变化的方式有关。

sentence_translations.sentence: As an expression of identity, language is adapted by different groups and different generations to reflect their own sense of self.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为身份的表达，语言被不同群体和不同世代加以调整，以反映他们自身的自我认知。

sentence_translations.sentence: their own sense of self.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们自身的自我认同感。

sentence_translations.sentence: It also needs to constantly assimilate fresh concepts as these evolve.
sentence_translations.translation: 它还需要随着新概念的发展不断吸收它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: Words are being created for these reasons all the time.
sentence_translations.translation: 出于这些原因，新词一直在被创造出来。

sentence_translations.sentence: But what's interesting about emojis is that they've contributed to this ever-expanding storehouse in a different way.
sentence_translations.translation: 但表情符号的有趣之处在于，它们以一种不同的方式为这个不断扩展的语料库做出了贡献。

sentence_translations.sentence: At this point in our history, the gaps in our vocabulary are being filled not simply by new words, but by an absolutely new system of expression.
sentence_translations.translation: 在我们历史的这一时刻，词汇中的空白不仅仅由新词填补，而是由一种全新的表达体系来填补。

sentence_translations.sentence: The second major reason that language changes is down to technology-specifically, the ways in which the technologies we use have an effect on the process of communication itself.
sentence_translations.translation: 语言变化的第二个主要原因在于技术，具体来说，便是我们使用的技术对交流过程本身产生影响的方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: The second major reason that language changes is down to technology-specifically, the ways in which the technologies we use have an effect on the process of communication itself.
sentence_translations.translation: 语言变化的第二个主要原因是技术——具体而言，就是我们使用的技术对交流过程本身产生影响的方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: Both hardware and new technologies result in us subtly changing the way we interact with each other and also altering the shape of the language we use.
sentence_translations.translation: 硬件和新技术都促使我们微妙地改变彼此互动的方式，同时也改变了我们所用语言的形态。

sentence_translations.sentence: Emojis have evolved as a solution to the needs of mobile communication.
sentence_translations.translation: 表情符号已演变为满足移动通信需求的解决方案。

sentence_translations.sentence: In particular, they compensate for the way that computer-mediated messaging on smartphones can sometimes tend towards the emotionally empty.
sentence_translations.translation: 具体来说，它们弥补了智能手机上通过计算机中介的信息传递有时可能趋于情感空洞的缺陷。

sentence_translations.sentence: Whereas face to-face, or even voice-to-voice, conversations can express emotional closeness through facial expression or tone of voice, this is easy to miss when messages are rendered in a few short words on a small screen.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管面对面甚至语音对话可以通过面部表情或语调表达情感亲近，但当信息在小屏幕上以简短词语呈现时，这种情感很容易被忽略。

sentence_translations.sentence: Emojis are a means of restoring this emotional framing to an interaction-punctuating your message with a smile.
sentence_translations.translation: 表情符号是一种在互动中恢复这种情感框架的方式——用微笑来点缀你的信息。

sentence_translations.sentence: But unlike almost any other type of language system, emojis have something akin to a built-in obsolescence.
sentence_translations.translation: 但与几乎任何其他类型的语言系统不同，表情符号具有某种类似内置过时性的特征。

sentence_translations.sentence: Just as smartphones and their operating systems have a frequent refresh rate, emojis also get routine enhancements.
sentence_translations.translation: 正如智能手机及其操作系统频繁更新换代一样，表情符号也定期得到增强。

sentence_translations.sentence: The emojis you have on your phone now will undergo subtle redesigns over the course of time, and extra characters will be added.
sentence_translations.translation: 你现在手机上的表情符号会随着时间的推移经历细微的重新设计，并且还会添加额外的字符。

sentence_translations.sentence: Because of this, their usefulness is artificially limited.
sentence_translations.translation: 正因如此，它们的实用性被人为地限制了。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the context of communication systems, this is something that's never previously been the case.
sentence_translations.translation: 在通信系统的背景下，这种情况前所未有。

sentence_translations.sentence: Twenty years ago, people might have bought a new landline phone when they were tired of the design of their old phone or if they wanted to get one with whatever latest innovation was going around-an inbuilt answering machine, say.
sentence_translations.translation: 二十年前，当人们厌倦了旧电话的设计，或者想要拥有一款搭载当下最新创新（例如内置应答机）的电话时，他们可能会购买一部新的固定电话。

sentence_translations.sentence: But they didn't have to upgrade the language they were using as well.
sentence_translations.translation: 但他们不必同时升级所使用的语言。

sentence_translations.sentence: Emojis, on the other hand, are a case study of how technology and the human capacity for communication are working together—of how the onward march of technology exists at the intersection of consumerism, innovation and design.
sentence_translations.translation: 另一方面，表情符号则是一个案例研究，展示了科技与人类沟通能力如何协同作用——也展示了技术的持续进步如何存在于消费主义、创新与设计的交汇点上。

sentence_translations.sentence: Moreover, the fact that they're at the front line of a relentless wave of technologically driven change in communications practices encourages—if not necessitates—a great amount of creativity in the way they're used.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，它们处于由技术驱动的沟通实践变革的无情浪潮的前沿这一事实，鼓励——甚至可以说是迫使——人们在它们的使用方式上投入大量的创造力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Finally, there's the way they've become implicated in almost all aspects of modern society, from politics and marketing to art and entertainment.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，它们已渗透到现代社会的几乎方方面面，从政治、市场营销到艺术和娱乐。

sentence_translations.sentence: Emojis are the subject of musicals and Hollywood films.
sentence_translations.translation: 表情符号已成为音乐剧和好莱坞电影的主题。

sentence_translations.sentence: They're the inspiration for fashion design, art and architecture.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们为时装设计、艺术和建筑提供了灵感。

sentence_translations.sentence: They're a staple in advertising and commerce.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们在广告和商业中已成为主要元素。

sentence_translations.sentence: Understanding why they've become so popular, and how they work, can not only explain something about the nature of language; it can also help us to understand our relationship with technology, society and ourselves.
